caveats: Each dataset reports a status: ok (count may be 0, meaning queried and none found), error (the query failed, so nothing is known: never show it as zero), or skipped.
Records are as of pulled_at. Check the live source before relying on one.
PLUTO and the building footprints can lag a demolition or a collapse.

stop_work_mentions lists records whose text mentions a stop-work order. It is not a complete list: we have not found stop-work orders published as their own dataset.
dob_311_requests and dob_complaints can hold the same complaint, and they share no key: never add their counts. 311 rows with no bbl, and rows before 2020, are missed.
DOB violations filed under a letter borough code (a few thousand of 2.5 million rows) are found only through a BIN.
reference_tables hold DOB's code tables as printed. The disposition table was last updated in 2017 (see rows_updated_at), and codes it lacks are shown as gaps, never guessed.
